proposals.before: Xiaoyu urged him to seek advancement; He Shikai deeply hated this, and therefore memorialized to remove Xiaoyu as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery and to send Yuanliang and the others out as well.
proposals.after: Xiaoyu urged him to seek advancement; He Shikai deeply hated this, and therefore memorialized to appoint Xiaoyu as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery and to send Yuanliang and the others out as well.
proposals.reason: Chinese 除…為 means to appoint someone to an office, not to remove them from that office; the literal English reverses the appointment sense.

proposals.before: Erzhu Wenchang was the fourth son of Rong.
proposals.after: Erzhu Wenchang was the fourth son of Erzhu Rong.
proposals.reason: Literal English drops the surname on 榮, obscuring that Rong is Erzhu Rong named in full in the idiomatic line.

decisions.reason: s0072 has 奏除孝裕為章武郡守: 除…為 is the standard appointment formula, not removal. The original literal reverses that sense; 'appoint … as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery' matches the Chinese and the sidelining of 元亮等皆出.

s0021 reads 榮第四子也, naming the father only as 榮. 'Fourth son of Rong' is accurate for the literal field; expanding to 'Erzhu Rong' is stylistic clarification already present in the idiomatic line, not a semantic error.
